coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 11 ground-truth items (55%): the FP16 versus QuaRot 4-bit comparison and all five dependent variables, including phase timings, end-to-end time, peak memory, and relative performance improvement.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design expands the fixed 7B architecture to 7B and 13B, replaces e2e/benchmark.py's methodology with a custom protocol, and varies batch size and prompt length instead of keeping them at 1 and 2048. It does not specify the required 32 decode steps. Additional quantization conditions and quality studies exceed the target experiment.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not match the expected performance comparison.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion reports the FP16 versus 4-bit prefill time, decoding time, memory usage, or phase-specific speedup factors.
